BusinessModel: Company collects tolls on highways, builds road and EPC infrastructure projects, and sells real estate. Runs tollways across 11 states and 1 union territory.
RevenueStreams: Toll collection (majority, FY25); EPC infra projects; real estate — exact split data not found
Expenses: Total expenses Rs 398 cr (FY25); borrowings Rs 61 cr (Mar FY25); cost split data not found
TAM: India road sector capex ~Rs 2.6 lakh cr/yr (FY24, NHAI/MoRTH budget); toll industry Rs 40,000+ cr/yr
PL_Top3_Contributors: Toll collection revenue (stable core); EPC execution margin pressure (OPM 7% FY24 to 5% FY25); real estate sales (small, lumpy)

BusinessModel: Company makes precured tread rubber for tyre retreading and sells tyres for LCVs, tractors and two/three-wheelers. Also makes bonding gum, solutions, flaps and tubes in-house, with Gulf exports.
RevenueStreams: PCTR retreading rubber (core, FY25); tyres LCV/agri/2W-3W; allied products and exports — exact split data not found
Expenses: Raw materials (natural rubber) dominant — OPM swung 10-18% (FY23-FY25); borrowings cut to ~Rs 4 cr; interest Rs 1 cr (FY26)
TAM: India tyre retreading market ~Rs 12,000-15,000 cr/yr (FY24 industry estimates)
PL_Top3_Contributors: PCTR tread rubber sales; natural rubber price moves (OPM 10-18% swing); tyre sales and Gulf exports

BusinessModel: Company runs a digital platform that manages corporate spending — prepaid cards, expense automation and reward/gift card programs. Connects banks, payment networks and company ERP systems.
RevenueStreams: Corporate payments/prepaid cards (bulk, FY25); employee tax-benefit programs; SaaS spend-management subscriptions — exact split data not found
Expenses: Total expenses Rs 1,187 cr (FY25) incl. payment pass-through costs; interest Rs 8 cr; depreciation Rs 15 cr; OPM ~9%
TAM: India corporate cards + employee benefits market Rs 50,000+ cr (FY24 industry estimates)
PL_Top3_Contributors: Payment volumes on prepaid cards; tax/benefit programs (taxi, food, gift cards); high-margin SaaS subscriptions

BusinessModel: Company provides flexible office space — single desks to custom offices for startups, SMEs and corporates. Ran 208 centers with 134,000+ seats across 18 cities (Mar FY25), mostly asset-light managed seats.
RevenueStreams: Workspace rental/seats (~95%, FY25); allied services (Fitouts by AWFIS etc.)
Expenses: FY25 expenses Rs 799 cr: rentals/CAM to partners ~Rs 387 cr; depreciation Rs 276 cr; interest Rs 136 cr
TAM: India flexible workspace ~55-65 mn sq ft, growing double-digit (2024 CBRE/JLL reports)
PL_Top3_Contributors: Seat occupancy/utilization; rental-CAM payouts to partners; depreciation and interest on fit-outs (Rs 412 cr combined FY25)

BusinessModel: Company runs a merchant commerce platform — POS machines, payment processing, gift card/prepaid issuance (Qwikcilver) and merchant lending/BNPL via Fave. Serves merchants, brands and banks.
RevenueStreams: Payment services/POS (core, FY25); gift card and prepaid issuance; embedded finance/BNPL — exact split data not found
Expenses: FY25 expenses Rs 1,421 cr incl. depreciation Rs 213 cr and interest Rs 70 cr; OPM 11% (FY25)
TAM: India merchant payments/POS industry revenue Rs 30,000+ cr (FY24 RBI/industry reports)
PL_Top3_Contributors: POS payment volumes; Qwikcilver gift card issuance (higher margin); depreciation and interest drag (Rs 283 cr FY25)

BusinessModel: Company builds and sells affordable and mid-segment apartments in Delhi NCR, mainly Gurugram. Claims 27% share in Gurugram affordable/mid housing (company disclosure).
RevenueStreams: Residential apartment sales, Gurugram/NCR (affordable + mid-segment, FY25); exact project mix data not found
Expenses: FY25 expenses Rs 1,747 cr; interest Rs 267 cr (TTM FY26); depreciation Rs 22 cr; borrowings Rs 3,275 cr (Mar FY26)
TAM: Indian residential real estate ~Rs 3-4 lakh cr annual sales (FY24 ANAROCK/industry)
PL_Top3_Contributors: Gurugram residential sales/prices (FY25 revenue doubled); interest cost Rs 267 cr FY26 (biggest drag); lumpy project completion recognition

BusinessModel: Company designs, makes and sells luxury and super-premium furniture — mainly sofas and seating — through its own store network across India. Vertically integrated from design to retail.
RevenueStreams: Sofa/seating (dominant, FY25); other furniture via Stanley, Sofas & More, Boutique and Level Next formats — exact split data not found
Expenses: TTM expenses Rs 192 cr incl. interest Rs 8 cr, depreciation Rs 15 cr; leather/foam inputs dominant; OPM 5-9%
TAM: Indian furniture market ~Rs 1.2-1.5 lakh cr (FY23 industry estimates); premium/luxury a small rising slice
PL_Top3_Contributors: Sofa/seating sales in own stores; other income Rs 22.6 cr padding PAT; leather/foam costs and store opex

BusinessModel: Company designs and manufactures room air conditioners and components (indoor and outdoor units) on an ODM basis for big brands, plus small appliances. Clients own the brand names.
RevenueStreams: RAC ODM manufacturing (dominant, FY25); small appliances; components — exact split data not found
Expenses: Copper/steel/aluminum raw materials dominate (OPM 6-8% FY23-FY25); interest Rs 61 cr; borrowings Rs 676 cr (Mar FY26)
TAM: Indian room AC market ~11-12 mn units/yr (FY24 industry estimates), under-10% household penetration
PL_Top3_Contributors: RAC ODM volumes for brand clients; copper/steel input costs; interest on Rs 676 cr debt (Rs 61 cr)

BusinessModel: Company sells general insurance — motor, health, travel, property, marine, liability — fully online through a digital model. It designs products, distributes via platform and partners, and settles claims.
RevenueStreams: Motor insurance (largest line, FY25); health; travel/property/marine/liability — exact GWP split data not found
Expenses: Claims payouts dominant (total expenses Rs 9,250 cr FY25 vs revenue Rs 9,370 cr); other income ~Rs 468-472 cr supports PAT
TAM: Indian non-life GWP ~Rs 2.5-2.9 lakh cr (FY24 IRDAI), underpenetrated, growing low-to-mid teens
PL_Top3_Contributors: Motor underwriting; investment/other income ~Rs 468-472 cr; health insurance growth

BusinessModel: Company runs the Uniware SaaS platform that manages e-commerce operations — orders, inventory, warehouses and omnichannel fulfilment — for 7,596+ brands, sellers and logistics firms in India, Middle East and Southeast Asia.
RevenueStreams: SaaS subscriptions on Uniware platform (dominant, FY25); setup/onboarding and allied services — exact split data not found
Expenses: TTM expenses Rs 85 cr — employees and technology dominate; OPM ~31%; borrowings ~Rs 1 cr
TAM: India e-commerce GMV projected >$100 bn (FY24 industry estimates); enablement SaaS a growing slice
